As-of-year, so the same person reads a lower level in an earlier cycle - a first-time candidate is 0 even if they later won office.

feats.label: Polled-margin trend
feats.desc: Whether the candidate's polled margin is improving or worsening.

feats.label: Days since last poll
feats.desc: Days between the candidate's latest poll and election day (staleness).

feats.label: Polling momentum (final-60d slope)
feats.desc: Slope of the candidate's polls over the final 60 days - rising or falling.

feats.label: Poll-to-poll variability
feats.desc: How much the candidate's poll numbers bounce around between surveys.

feats.label: Polling lead, final 7 days (pts)
feats.desc: Final-week polling lead over the best opponent. Unlike the overall polling lead, this ignores early-campaign polls entirely.

feats.label: Most recent poll (%)
feats.desc: The candidate's share in the most recent dated poll.

feats.label: Polling avg, final 30 days (%)
feats.desc: Average over polls taken in the final 30 days before the election.

feats.label: Share of race polling
feats.desc: Candidate's slice of all polling support in the race.

feats.label: Polling lead x recency
feats.desc: Polling lead discounted by how stale the latest poll is - a fresh lead counts more than an old one.

feats.label: Polling lead vs best opponent (pts)
feats.desc: Candidate's polling average minus the best opponent's.
